desk: The storm passed. Draft hype and early-season noise carried the league through four weeks, and Week 4 arrived with a thin chat log, a scoreboard doing most of the talking, and ten games left before the playoffs. Teams are still searching for an identity, and the block shows it: Darkspaces listed Nico Collins and pitched Swift for a first, and YesChef23 posted George Pickens. No trade cleared this week. The deadline will change that.

On the field, Darkspaces set a perfect lineup, 118.36 with nothing left on the bench, and lost by 65.06 to CMac91's 183.42, the high score of the week. A perfect lineup is only as good as the roster behind it, and MAXPF, the points of each week's best possible lineup added up, now gives Darkspaces the league's lowest total and the 1.01. Zygon beat Hades9mm and is the only unbeaten team. Painty69 lost by 1.34 and is the only winless one.

paras: Week 4 was the calm after the storm. The draft hype and the early scramble have burned off, the first third of the regular season is behind us, and most teams are still working out what they are. Ten games remain before the playoffs, and the urge to trade grows every week the block stays open.

The field is clearer than the chat. Zygon is the only 4-0 team, Hades9mm and Johnny4Skins sit at 3-1, six teams are bunched at 2-2, and Painty69 is the lone 0-4. Darkspaces holds the 1.01 on MAXPF, Snipe58 the 1.02 and StealingGas the 1.03, which keeps the tank math alive.

Issue 4's poll went four votes to Painty69 staying in the bottom three, one to Sarge71, and none for StealingGas or the field. Next up: Zygon vs C33DeezNutzz for the unbeaten crown, Darkspaces needing a bounce-back against Johnny4Skins, and a new poll below. Cast your vote, then go start somebody.
